record.where: The Republic in force (v3.32 — the CK3 sandbox foundation)

clauses.text: the registries seed real open ground
the seals hold against play
the truce gates then walks and stands the camps AND the horns down
the rising douses a lamp with no core posted
the parley and the quell each restore it
the quell marching on real ground, paying appreciation, raising a Standing Teeth stone
the shrines feed and climb the ladder
the procession harvests only what walks in
the far shape stands whole in frame
the mountain road cuts and lives the whole kit
the class-read intercept drops a runner at range
the hall is walked end to end
the banner sheet obeys the modal law with no TODO anywhere
One ordered ladder — Absolute Ally · Ally · Friendly · Wary · Hostile · Absolute Hostile · Unknown — and a RULES row per banner saying what play may move it and through which gate.
Waylight and Farkeep are SEALED ABSOLUTE_ALLY by the founding; the Reapers and Hollow Fires SEALED ABSOLUTE_HOSTILE (shoot on sight is mercy). No play moves a seal.
the Raiders can be brought to a WARY TRUCE at Road's-Own renegade standing
the Flame Keepers climb Wary → Friendly → Ally as you FEED their shrines
the Lamplighters and the Diefenbunker MIRROR ledgers that already exist (the guild rank, the cold door)
A town whose people decide the wire is a leash douses its own waylight BY CHOICE — political dark, not starvation, and NO delivered core will answer it.

THE QUELL sends a column of Farkeeper shields that MARCHES the real road (snapped to the crossings like any walker), restores the light by force, costs the town's love, and can cost the mountain a name — a casualty raises a stone on the Standing Teeth.
THE PARLEY is your own boots at their cold fire, a gift of stores
gated behind a town that loved you once
The first rising is authored (the stone-cutters at the Quarry)
The Flame Keepers' shrines stand on the walked ways — a stone bowl you FEED with carried lumen, burning tall for most of a day, warming their stance.

figure.note: the fed bowl burns past the moment it is fed and stands tall on the ground; the length of its burn against the day is not read

clauses.text: The Hollow Fires' larders burn far from every station
The Reapers cross the night grey in a hooded FILE that harvests only what walks into it — no chase.
sighted, mailed, and after three sightings the Republic posts a standing watch

figure.note: the first sighting mails, the second mails again, the third posts the standing watch (gi.seen === 3)

clauses.text: The far shape draws LATE, after the mist that would otherwise bury it, with the world transform restored by hand
a road-gang project on the Darklands table's far east edge

When it opens, the Farlands go live on the globe, Farkeep answers the wire with its own desk, and the kit of the mountain HIRES — the Longbowman (answers trouble at 320), the Rifle Rider (a breech and a horse, 380), the Berserker (a claymore and a horrible knock up close).

figure.note: the kit rows read range 320 and 380, and cut, every class row lives with those stats

clauses.text: The intercept READS THE CLASS ROW: a ward meets a runner from its own trade — a fist knocks him flat, a bow or a breech DROPS him where he stands.

The cold door, once knocked open (v3.30), now STEPS INSIDE — a registry ROOM with its own floor: concrete ribs, cold strip light, lockers, the SBSN log desk you can read standing up, the brass wall of a century's names, and the armory cage with the red-stencilled C20 crate. Nothing made of grey follows you in.
